# PureAI Studio

> 100% client-side browser tool to inspect and remove C2PA Content Credentials ("Made with AI" / "AI Info" labels), JUMBF manifests, IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia tags, ComfyUI PNG workflow JSON graphs, MP4 video metadata boxes (Sora, Runway, Kling, Luma), EXIF GPS coordinates, and invisible LLM Unicode watermarks (U+202F, U+200B, U+2060). Zero server uploads — files never leave the user's device.

## Core Capabilities
- **Free C2PA / SynthID / EXIF Forensic Threat Inspector:** Unlimited local inspection of JPEG, PNG, WebP, and MP4 files before publishing to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Fanvue, or stock agencies.
- **Image & MP4 Video Metadata Scrubber:** Strips binary C2PA/JUMBF containers, XMP, ComfyUI `tEXt`/`iTXt` prompt workflows, and MP4 `udta`/`meta`/`uuid` provenance atoms locally in WebAssembly/Canvas.
- **Optional Camera Technical EXIF Profiles:** Writes valid binary `APP1 (Exif)` headers (`Apple iPhone 16 Pro`, `Sony Alpha A7 IV`, `Canon EOS R5`) or exports 100% lossless container-stripped files.
- **Bulk Batch .ZIP Processing:** Processes up to 100 mixed photos and `.MP4` videos into a single clean `.ZIP` archive locally.
- **Invisible Unicode Watermark Cleaner:** Detects and strips `U+202F` (narrow no-break space), `U+200B` (zero-width space), and `U+FEFF` inserted by ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

## Pricing (No Forced Subscription)
- **Free Tier:** Unlimited C2PA/EXIF/Unicode forensic scanning + 1 free clean photo/video export.
- **10-File Quick Pass:** €2.99 (~$3.39 / £2.59) one-time payment, never expires.
- **50-File Creator Pack + Batch .ZIP:** €9.90 (~$11.29 / £8.59) one-time payment, never expires.
- **Unlimited Annual Studio:** €39/year (~$44/yr / £34/yr), up to 4 devices.

## Key Tools & Guides
- [Main Web Studio (EN/ES/DE/FR/PT)](https://pureaistudios.com/clean-ai-studio.html): Interactive C2PA/EXIF photo, MP4 video, batch `.ZIP`, and Unicode studio.
- [Free Online C2PA Content Credentials Viewer & Debugger](https://pureaistudios.com/c2pa-content-credentials-viewer-debugger-online-free.html): Inspect hidden C2PA/JUMBF manifests in photos and videos.
- [Remove C2PA Metadata from MP4 AI Videos (Sora, Runway, Kling, Reels)](https://pureaistudios.com/remove-c2pa-metadata-mp4-video-sora-runway-kling.html): Strip AI provenance atoms from `.MP4` videos locally.
- [Strip ComfyUI Workflow JSON & Prompts from PNG](https://pureaistudios.com/strip-comfyui-workflow-json-png-keep-prompts-private.html): Protect proprietary LoRAs, seeds, and node graphs before sharing on Civitai, Reddit, or Discord.
- [Fix False 'Made with AI' Label from Photoshop & Lightroom on Instagram](https://pureaistudios.com/fix-photoshop-lightroom-false-made-with-ai-label-instagram.html): Remove accidental C2PA tags triggered by minor retouching or AI denoise on real camera photos.
- [Camera EXIF Profile Tool (iPhone 16 Pro / Sony A7IV / Canon R5)](https://pureaistudios.com/exif-camera-injector-iphone-sony-ai-photos.html): Add standard technical APP1 EXIF camera headers locally.
- [Remove EXIF GPS Location Before Posting Online](https://pureaistudios.com/remove-exif-gps-location-before-posting-reddit-marketplace.html): Strip smartphone GPS coordinates for personal privacy.
- [Is This Photo or Video AI? Free C2PA & EXIF Detector](https://pureaistudios.com/ai-photo-detector.html): Instant local AI provenance detector with downloadable Forensic Proof Certificate (available in 10 languages).
- [ComfyUI & PNG Prompt Workflow Inspector](https://pureaistudios.com/png-prompt-inspector.html): Parse and strip hidden `tEXt`/`iTXt` JSON workflows, seeds, and LoRA weights locally.
- [Private WebP & PNG to Clean sRGB JPG Converter](https://pureaistudios.com/webp-png-to-jpg-clean.html): Convert DALL-E/ChatGPT WebP images into C2PA-free JPEGs offline.
- [MP4 HD First & Last Frame Extractor](https://pureaistudios.com/mp4-frame-extractor.html): Extract C2PA-free HD PNG keyframes from MP4 videos for Kling, Runway, Sora, and Veo chaining.
- [Free Embeddable C2PA & EXIF Scanner Widget](https://pureaistudios.com/embed-scanner.html): Zero-upload `<iframe>` widget for blogs, Notion, and developer docs.
- [Official RSS 2.0 Tools Feed](https://pureaistudios.com/feed.xml): Syndicated updates of all interactive privacy utilities.
- [Chrome Web Store Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pureai-studio-%E2%80%94-c2pa-meta/pdebjlkmjdhpgiigepojdcpfbfimcgmo): Official Manifest V3 browser extension.
- [Official Telegram C2PA & GPS Scanner Bot (@PureAIScannerBot)](https://t.me/PureAIScannerBot): Free instant RAM metadata scanner inside Telegram.
- [Full Documentation for AI Assistants](https://pureaistudios.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed technical FAQ and format support matrix.
